verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. The State Council's page on gov.cn could not be reached on 18 Oct 2026 (DNS lookup failed), so its copy of 16 Oct 2026 was read: the notice and the full plan in Chinese. It confirms the document number 国发〔2017〕35号, the State Council as issuer, the date of the notice (成文日期 8 Jul 2017, also under the State Council's signature) and the release date (发布日期 20 Jul 2017), and the plan's goals, safeguards and implementation sections. No English text by the State Council was found; the English title renders the Chinese title and matches the name DigiChina uses in its third-party English translation, stored on 16 Oct 2026. The summary follows the Chinese text. 安全 is rendered 'safety', as in the official English title of 人工智能安全治理框架 (CN-07); DigiChina renders 人工智能安全监管和评估体系, 安全评估和管控能力 and 安全认证 with 'security'.

judgment.status_reasoning: A State Council plan (规划) sent to provincial governments and State Council departments for implementation, with goals to 2020, 2025 and 2030; it is a policy plan, not a law or regulation, so it is non-binding. Its last horizon (2030) has not passed, and nothing stored shows it replaced or withdrawn; the State Council's 'AI+' Opinions of 2025 (CN-12) are a separate, later instrument. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands. It sets no in-force date.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published 2017-07-08 is the date of the notice (成文日期, and the date under the State Council's signature); the page's 发布日期 is 2017-07-20, the release date given in the notes.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Mainly a national plan for AI research, industry and adoption whose safety content sits in the safeguards on laws, ethics and a safety supervision and assessment system; the existing scope_note fits and is kept.
